h1.en: HBT8018 vs Diesel 120 Concrete Pump: 132 kW beside the Governor (device) article
h1.zh: HBT8018和柴油120混凝土泵有何不同：对照「Governor (device)」时，132 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: HBT8018 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. HBT8018 lists a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device).
directAnswer.zh: HBT8018 和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。HBT8018 标出 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device). The picture shows Ashton Frost engine governor. HBT8018 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Aggregate is 4 cm and below on HBT8018 and 6 cm and below on Diesel 120. Dimensions: HBT8018 lists 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. HBT8018 lists entries that Diesel 120 does not: Model line HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Motor power 132 kW. Pumping pressure 40 MPa. Conveying distance 150 m. Delivery height 450 m. The shared 150 m figure is a conveying-distance entry on HBT8018 and the horizontal side of a pair on Diesel 120. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)。画面是Ashton Frost engine governor。HBT8018 和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。骨料在 HBT8018 为 4 cm 及以下，在柴油120为 6 cm 及以下。外形尺寸：HBT8018标出 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm；柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。柴油120有、HBT8018没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；最大出口压力 40 MPa；料斗容积 0.6 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: HBT8018 lists a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m. Theoretical output: HBT8018 lists 60 m³/h. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. Diesel 120 lists entries that HBT8018 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.6 m³. Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Open /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018 and /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: HBT8018 标出 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。理论输送量：HBT8018标出 60 m³/h；柴油120标出 100 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。相同的 150 m，在 HBT8018 是输送距离格，在柴油120是数对里的水平一侧。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Diesel 120 lists 290 kW as two 145 kW units, 100 m³/h and distance 150 m / 500 m. Max. aggregate size: HBT8018 lists 4 cm and below. Diesel 120 lists 6 cm and below. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 柴油120标出 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、100 m³/h、距离 150 m / 500 m。最大骨料粒径：HBT8018标出 4 cm and below；柴油120标出 6 cm and below。HBT8018有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S；电机功率 132 kW；泵送压力 40 MPa；输送距离 150 m；输送高度 450 m。看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/，看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does HBT8018 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists 60 m³/h. Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device).
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 60 m³/h。柴油120标出 100 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does HBT8018 list the same max. aggregate size as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists 4 cm and below. Diesel 120 lists 6 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device).
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 4 cm and below。柴油120标出 6 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does HBT8018 list the same dimensions as Diesel 120?
question.zh: HBT8018和柴油120的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Diesel 120 lists 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device).
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm。柴油120标出 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is model line missing on Diesel 120?
question.zh: 为什么柴油120没有型号行？

answer.en: The Diesel 120 page does not list that label. HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device).
answer.zh: 柴油120这一页没有标出这个标题。HBT8018标出的是 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor_(device)画面里印出的数字。
